cross_session.note: fleet prover latency is processor-state bound: the fleet rows tabulated in results[] are the mean of two cool/boosted sessions (175.7/348.8/632.2 ms), reproduced across runs and consistent with the 2026-09-14 session (168.6/336.9/608.0 ms). Under sustained load the same machine drops to ~207-259/394-418/696-747 ms, and the earlier archived session reached 405/842/1526 ms. Stopping and idling for 150 s did not restore the boosted mode (free RAM 4.5 GB, CPU load 9%, package temperature ~28 C), so the spread is a boost/PL state effect rather than RAM or thermal pressure. The per-microgrid row is unaffected throughout (50.4-53.6 ms, medians 50.1 and 51.0 over two 25-run sessions).
